title: Title and abstract screening for a systematic review

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: Sixteen invented records stand in for the database exports; two are duplicates across sources and are removed before the queue. Decisions, notes, term lists and screener initials are kept in localStorage. The CSV has one row per exported record, duplicates included, so two screeners' files can be joined by record id.
